title: On the number of permutation-twisted dot products
summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be a field of characteristic $0$. For each choice of distinct $a_1, \ldots, a_n\in \mathbb{K}$ and distinct $b_1, \ldots, b_n\in \mathbb{K}$, consider the sum $S=\sum_{i=1}^n a_i b_{π(i)}$ as $π$ ranges over the permutations of $[n]$. We show that this sum always assumes at least $Ω(n^3)$ distinct values.
